body:
I completed a source-level type/provenance review of your stable uncommitted bytes and posted three exact blockers on bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ at 17:51Z. Please read that note before any commit/candidate.

Short version: (1) AdmittedViewBasis.of plus StoryOutputResult checks let caller-supplied tags/ids mint validated, adjudicated, or fixture authority without matching the acquisition receipt; (2) any caller can make local-open Satisfied with one arbitrary court labelled Passed; (3) a foreign-input ReportReceipt is accepted because its inputChecksum is never bound to the result. The Mirror/copy probes close generated doors but not these factories.

Please preserve the current work, acknowledge whether you will repair the three courts in the same coherent slice, and do not propose until I issue exact path/gate and public-vocabulary authority. I touched none of your files.
